data.title: Method-Level Bug Prediction: How Far Are We?
data.authors: Md Nahidul Islam Opu, Md. Masud Mazumder, Muhammad Asaduzzaman, Shaiful Chowdhury
data.venue: International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE), Research Track
data.summary: A realistic method-level bug prediction pipeline combining LLM-based label cleaning, code embeddings, and time-sensitive cross-project evaluation — revealing persistent generalization challenges.

data.title: How Do Agentic AI Systems Deal With Software Energy Concerns? A Pull Request-Based Study
data.authors: Tanjum Motin Mitul, Md. Masud Mazumder, Shaiful Chowdhury
data.venue: 23rd International Conference on Mining Software Repositories (MSR), Challenge Track
data.note: Equal contribution with the first author
data.summary: Thematic analysis of 216 energy-explicit pull requests in LLM-based coding agents, producing a taxonomy of five energy concern categories and 21 optimization techniques, with an analysis of PR acceptance patterns across the AIDev dataset.
